author: ankushindaniil
content:
Hey guys, could you review these PRs if you have a chance? 🙏 

https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/12121 links the first reference to each cited proposal
https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/12091 specifies block inclusion gating and the payer
https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/12066 bans SLOTNUM during validation prefix execution
https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/12061 notes that a frame receipt carries no transaction level fields
https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/12026 clarifies floor repricing and signature validation

Tests for the introspection instructions are open against the execution-specs prototype: https://github.com/SamWilsn/eth1.0-specs/pull/11. 

Receipt fields are also open in execution-apis: https://github.com/ethereum/execution-apis/pull/860
